corrections.finding: M0608 kappa is a compact probe, not c*N.
Q_obs is a shifted contact-source observation, not automatically original j or stable Y_j.
Raw constrained normals have dimension 2q before parity; the six-dimensional primitive is a different carrier.
M0608 repairs constrained real-zero simplicity under explicit domain hypotheses; PSD alone is not its proof.
The local zero ideal must be in holomorphic germs, not the meromorphic field.
Multipliers divisible by zeta or congruent to one do not exhaust all linear holomorphic multipliers.
Punctured equality does not permit evaluating a totalized division expression at its singular center.
Holomorphic completed input can have the nonzero transferred jet; analyticity is not vanishing.
An entire addition can cancel a completed leading coefficient unless the correction is retained.
Repeated completion derivatives require factorial and Leibniz binomial factors.
At order 2m-1 an extra completion does not automatically eliminate the history term.
No theorem excludes all linear closing methods or all unlisted operators.
A positive integral of rank-one matrices need not have rank one.
DC1 does not preserve the exact dominant eigenvalue or give a universal operator norm.
A logarithmic rate equality is not an asymptotic-ratio statement E~exp(2Theta T).
Small individual stage costs do not imply small accumulated products and propagated errors.
Fixed source/palette rapid decay does not provide a uniform O(1) localization under growing palette and order.
High primitive mask is max(a,b)>B, not both a,b>B.
For balanced c_r the common gcd can share primes with primitive indices; coprimality restriction can delete genuine terms.
Absorbing factors into the kernel preserves the scalar field, not the old mask; A3 supplies a separately priced comparison.
The rational coherent channel includes off-diagonal pairs, not only d=e.
A contrast can annihilate exactly the target sum; a recovery theorem is necessary.
Seven identities for six coefficients need not be inconsistent.
Off-line nonvanishing cannot be automatically applied at critical-line evaluation points where the real-zero generator may vanish.
Nonlinearity, cross-zero coupling and spatial truncation are candidates, not proven necessary escape rules.
L1 weight alone does not define the noncompact symmetric comb integral; e^(t/2) growth must be controlled.
A continued Laplace value outside its convergence half-plane is not a zero integral moment; zeta(rho) is not a convergent raw Dirichlet sum in the strip.
A causal Dirichlet shift has factor D(z+1/2), hence D(1-s) after the stated substitution.
The trigonometric expansion of 2Re[i(lambda-1/2)e^(-lambda t)] has the opposite sine sign from the printed expansion.
The square of a decaying adjoint mode has Laplace pole at -2delta, not +2delta.
Fejer kernel and native completion have a rational additive correction; a pointwise ratio does not identify convolution operators.
The summed Fejer kernel has cusps at log integers; termwise double zeros do not justify a zero derivative of the infinite sum.
The rapidly decaying Fejer weight already makes a crude native field square integrable; finiteness supplies no RH-strength upper.
The simplest spatial/Fourier commutator of a selfdual input is anti-selfdual.
The provided Fourier cutoff reaches +-1 and is C1, not a smooth compact interior-frequency bump.
Attached Python is 31 lines and computes six numerical samples only; it does not execute the later analytic claims.
A local positive pairing or locally reduced negative mass does not violate a global signed-measure balance without an exterior bound.
